description: This file defines the User class, which models user data including id, name, email, role, and token, along with JSON serialization and copy methods.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A data model representing a user with attributes such as id, name, email, role, and token. Includes factory method for JSON deserialization, toJson for serialization, and copyWith for creating modified copies.

methods.name: User.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a User instance from a JSON map, optionally accepting a token.

methods.name: User.toJson
methods.description: Converts the User instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: User.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the User instance with an optional new token.
